key_findings: Pramipexole ameliorated sciatic nerve histopathology in STZ diabetic rats and downregulated the TLR4/MyD88/IRAK-1/TRAF-6/NF-κB axis and TNF-α, IL-1β, ICAM-1.
Neuroprotection is attributed to modulating TLR4/NF-κB signaling with reduced oxidative stress and inflammation.
